goal: Deploy the official Medusa backend and native Admin as a standalone Hub development service, keeping all commerce and Hub billing flows separate.
approach: Build only backend/Admin from frozen upstream dependencies; validate independent runtime settings; configure Redis modules and persistent development uploads; run safe migrations without upstream demo seeds; start compiled backend under node.

review.first_pass: No commerce API or core changes; default seeds are explicitly skipped. Existing storefront and upstream lockfile untouched. Runtime secrets independent and minimum 32 characters.
review.fixed_finding: Explicitly preserve backend CLI bin PATH in compiled working directory. Use the actual telemetry variable MEDUSA_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.
review.second_pass: All authored source under 400 lines. Frozen packages unchanged. No Hub billing imports, credentials, transaction mapping or SSO added. Start and migration use the same compiled config; persistent static directory assigned to node before dropping privilege.

remaining_risk: No local Docker daemon available: image runtime and database migration must be verified by the parent on isolated Railway resources.
Native login, volume persistence and live readiness are separate parent acceptance steps.
Actual payment providers, storefront and production deployment are not configured or tested.
Local file provider is for the isolated development instance only.
